content_sections.heading: About CHF CAU Pasighat
content_sections.text: The College of Horticulture and Forestry is a college of the Central Agricultural University (Imphal), located at Pasighat-791102, Arunachal Pradesh. This recruitment is for a project being implemented by the college's Department of Basic Sciences and Humanities, with funding from the National Medicinal Plants Board (NMPB). The project deals with the conservation and sustainable production of elite genotypes of Berberis aristata DC. (Daruharidra) through tissue culture.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: The table below gives the eligibility for the Project Associate-I (PAT-I) post exactly as printed in the notice. NET or GATE is not part of the essential qualification. It decides the pay: candidates who have qualified CSIR-UGC/ICAR/ICMR NET including Lectureship/Assistant Professorship or GATE get the higher rate (see Pay and Tenure below). The upper age limit is 35 years. Age relaxation for SC/ST/OBC/Women candidates shall be as per Government of India norms. The application form asks candidates to state their age as on the date of interview. Candidates should check the official notification for the discipline-specific eligibility of the post.

rows.essential_qualification: M.Sc. in Agriculture Biotechnology/Molecular Biology and Biotechnology/Plant Biotechnology/Life Sciences.

content_sections.text: The notice gives two rates of emoluments, both with HRA as per the funding agency: The position is purely temporary, contractual and co-terminus with the project. The initial engagement will be for one year, extendable based on performance and project requirement. The selected candidate shall have no claim for regular appointment or absorption in CAU.

content_sections.text: Applications are sent by email. The notice prints the application form on its pages 3 and 4. Fill the application form in the prescribed proforma: general information, educational qualifications from 10th standard onwards (including NET, if any), experience details, research papers and professional achievements, and any other relevant information. Paste a recent passport-size photograph, duly signed, on the form. Sign the declaration with place and date. Attach all relevant documents listed below. Send the duly filled application with the documents to [email protected] / [email protected] on or before 16 November 2026 (Monday). Self-attested copies of educational qualifications Self-attested copies of experience certificates (if any) Self-attested copies of research papers, professional achievements and additional information No Objection Certificate (NOC) from the employer, for candidates currently employed Original certificates, to be brought at the time of interview

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: Selection will be based on academic performance, experience and performance in the interview. The date and time of the interview will be communicated separately to shortlisted candidates through e-mail. Eligible candidates must bring the duly filled application in the prescribed proforma along with self-attested photocopies and original certificates at the time of interview. No TA/DA shall be paid for attending the interview.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are there in CHF CAU Pasighat Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There is one (01) Project Associate-I (PAT-I) post under the NMPB-funded Berberis aristata tissue culture project.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for the CHF CAU Pasighat Project Associate-I post?
faq.answer: Applications must be sent on or before 16 November 2026 (Monday).

faq.question: Q3. What qualification is required for the Project Associate-I (PAT-I) post?
faq.answer: The essential qualification is an M.Sc. in Agriculture Biotechnology/Molecular Biology and Biotechnology/Plant Biotechnology/Life Sciences; experience in Plant Tissue Culture is desirable.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for the CHF CAU Pasighat Project Associate-I post?
faq.answer: The upper age limit is 35 years, with relaxation as per Government of India norms.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary of a Project Associate-I at CHF CAU Pasighat?
faq.answer: The pay is Rs. 31,000/- per month + HRA for CSIR-UGC/ICAR/ICMR NET or GATE qualified candidates, and Rs. 25000/- per month + HRA for others.

faq.question: Q6. Is HRA paid on top of the Project Associate-I pay?
faq.answer: Yes, HRA is paid in addition to both pay rates, as per the funding agency.

faq.question: Q7. How do I apply for the CHF CAU Pasighat Project Associate-I post?
faq.answer: Fill the prescribed application form and email it with all relevant documents to [email protected] / [email protected] by 16 November 2026.

faq.question: Q8. How will the Project Associate-I be selected?
faq.answer: Selection will be based on academic performance, experience and performance in the interview; the interview date and time will be emailed to shortlisted candidates.

faq.question: Q9. Who gets age relaxation for the Project Associate-I post?
faq.answer: SC/ST/OBC/Women candidates get age relaxation as per Government of India norms.

faq.question: Q10. Is the CHF CAU Pasighat Project Associate-I job permanent?
faq.answer: No, the position is purely temporary, contractual and co-terminus with the project, initially for one year, and gives no claim to regular appointment or absorption in CAU.
